$comment: Languages ynotPDF ships (M130). en-GB is the source language: every fallback string in the code is written in it. A language listed here without a matching <id>.json catalogue is simply not offered, so adding one is: write the catalogue, add the line. Generated variants (see spelling-*.json) are produced by `node scripts/extract-i18n.ts`.
